metadata.title: MedOrbits Testimonials
metadata.description: Genuine feedback from students, parents and professionals who agreed to have it published. No testimonial may be invented, edited to change its meaning, or paid for without disclosure.
metadata.authenticityPolicy: Publish only real, consented feedback received by MedOrbits. Never write, buy, or fabricate testimonials, and never use placeholder or sample reviews on the live site.

displayName.note: Name as the person agreed to show; may be initials or first name only.

yearOfExperience.note: Year the person used the service or got the guidance.

quote.note: Short excerpt shown on cards; must appear in fullFeedback.

rating.note: Only the rating the person actually gave.

originalLanguageText.note: Keep the original when the displayed quote is a translation.

incentiveDisclosure.note: Required text when isIncentivised is true.

outcomeClaim.note: Set when the testimonial states an admission, job, rank or similar result.

dataRules: Never invent, ghost-write or fabricate testimonials, and never publish sample or placeholder testimonials on the live site.
Each testimonial must come from a real person who gave explicit consent to publish; consent.publishConsentGiven must be true with a consentDate before moderationStatus can be 'approved'.
A person's name and photo may be shown only if namePublishConsent and photoPublishConsent are true; otherwise use initials or anonymous.
If the author is under 18, guardianConsentIfMinor must be true, and the full name and photo must not be shown.
Contributors may withdraw consent at any time; on withdrawal set moderationStatus to 'withdrawn' and hide the item promptly.
Edits are limited to spelling, grammar, trimming and privacy redaction, and must not change meaning; keep a record in edits and original text where translated.
quote must be an unaltered excerpt of fullFeedback, within maxLength.
rating must be the value the person gave; never average, round up or add ratings.
If a testimonial claims an outcome (admission, rank, scholarship, job), set outcomeClaim and do not display it unless MedOrbits can reasonably support it, and always label that results vary.
Never present a testimonial as a guarantee or typical result of MedOrbits, an institution or any service.
Incentivised testimonials must set isIncentivised true and display incentiveDisclosure.
Do not publish testimonials that name or criticise individuals, contain contact details, health information or other personal data about third parties.
Do not publish testimonials that endorse a specific institution unless relatedInstitutionId is set and any commercial relationship is disclosed.
relatedCourseId, relatedInstitutionId and stateId must reference existing records.
Negative or mixed feedback must not be suppressed solely because it is unfavourable; moderation is for policy compliance.
The active field controls display only.

displayRules.resultsDisclaimer: Testimonials reflect individual experiences. Results vary and no admission, job, funding or outcome is guaranteed.
